description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests related to network device configuration, specifically managing bridge mode and IGMP snooping settings. It processes POST data, updates device settings via setStr() calls, and returns JSON responses.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a configuration string value for device parameters.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration string value from device parameters.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array.
